description.p: Restic Viewer attaches to Repositories you already back up elsewhere (via the restic CLI, cron, or another tool), lets you browse their Snapshots and file trees, and restores what you need. It doesn't run backups, doesn't schedule anything, and doesn't touch your Repository's data.

ul.li: Browse Local, SFTP, and S3-compatible Repositories
List Snapshots, filter and sort them, and walk their file trees
Search a Snapshot by file name and preview text and images in place
Compare two Snapshots to see what was added, removed or changed
Save a file, or a folder as a tar or zip archive, without restoring it
Restore individual files or a whole Snapshot, to a new directory or the original path, with include and exclude patterns and optional verification
Repository health: size and content totals, and restic's read-only integrity check
Live restore progress with cancel support
Repository passwords and Backend credentials stored in the system keyring
